headline: A law renaming a South Carolina post office in Easley after Private First Class Barrett Lyle Austin.
what_it_does: This law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service building at 810 South Pendleton Street in Easley, South Carolina. The building will be called the Private First Class Barrett Lyle Austin Post Office Building. It does not change how mail is delivered or how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 11, 2022.
